name: wolftac-factory
description: Spec, build, and independently review one issue at a time through the Wolftac software factory.

interface.longDescription: Creates build-ready Linear specifications, implements one queued issue in an isolated worktree, and independently reviews the published commit before completion.
defaultPrompt: Use $wolftac-build to build one queued issue.
Use $wolftac-review to review one built issue.
